name: SamSwat's EOTECH VUDU OVERHAUL - Reupload
teaser: Updated reticles with simulated variable zoom
description_html:
Check the original mod page for details. Adds multiple magnificaiton levels to the Eotech Vudu. If used with my FOV Fix + Variable Optics mod and enabling compatibility in the config, allows you to smoothly switch between each zoom level.

For compatibility with FOV Fix + Variable Optics

  • Make sure your folder structure looks like: user/mods/zzSamSWAT-EOTechVuduOverhaul
  • Make sure it’s loading after FOV Fix and Geff’s Scope Overhaul if you’re using that
  • Make sure “SamSwat Vudu Compatibility” is enabled in the F12 config menu for FOV Fix.
